blocks.text: OLONGAPO CITY — Nine of the 17 people on the Zabali Bridge in Baler, Aurora, fell into the Kinalapan River after a cable on one side came loose, causing the structure to tilt on Nov. 20, according to the Baler Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO). In a phone interview on Sunday, Arturo Molina, head of the Baler MDRRMO, said they received a report about the incident at 10:17 a.m. and immediately coordinated with the barangay concerned. The Baler MDRRMO also coordinated with the Aurora Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) to request additional resources before responders […]...
